text: But he gave no sign of pain, and with his single right hand helped us lash the boat in its place. “Stand by to let that jib over, you Oofty!” Wolf Larsen commanded, the very second we had finished with the boat. “Kelly, come aft and slack off the main-sheet! You, Kerfoot, go for’ard and see what’s become of Cooky! Mr. Van Weyden, run aloft again, and cut away any stray stuff on your way!” And having commanded, he went aft with his peculiar tigerish leaps to the wheel.
